resilience.note: Mutated skin & scrap armour plating: AR 2

bonuses.name: Favoured Prey
bonuses.text: If the target of this Threat's attack has any Augmetics, add +1 ED to any melee attack.

abilities.name: Scatter
abilities.text: Once per Round, when another Iron Feeder within 10 m of this Threat is killed, this Threat can take an immediate Movement Action.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.text: When an Iron Feeder succeeds in a melee attack as part of an ambush, the GM can add +1 ED per point of Ruin they choose to spend.
